title: Visiting his father in Kansas City
summary: Gus returns to Kansas City to see his father, a Santa Fe railroad man, and talks about whom he resembles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
